The factor by which the system wants things on a display to be larger than normal, so that they are as big on a display with many pixels per inch as on one with few. 1.0 is normal, 2.0 is twice as large. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals have no way to ask for more than the main display.
@param display  The display number, from 1 to [CountDisplays](CountDisplays).
@returns The scale, or 0 if the display does not exist.
@gap A display number that does not exist gives 0 (an empty text for the name) instead of stopping the program, because a display can be unplugged while the program runs.
